questions.A: raising all import quotas to record levels
questions.B: devaluing the currency and cutting imports

questions.subject: Economics
questions.q: The level of savings in an economy is chiefly determined by
questions.A: the level of income and the rate of interest
questions.B: the colour of the printed currency notes
questions.C: the number of commercial bank branches alone
questions.D: the size of the country's civil service
questions.explanation: People save from what is left after spending.

questions.subject: Economics
questions.q: The main determinants of investment in an economy are
questions.A: the expected profit and the rate of interest
questions.B: the price of garri and yam
questions.C: the number of commercial banks alone

questions.explanation: Money moves where the return beats the interest.
